owner_entity: Wolf Co. — Ivy Wolf Art is a brand of Wolf Co.
audience: Two buyers. FIRST, individuals who want an individual painting made for them — a family portrait, a place that matters to them, a landscape — across Panama, the United States, Mexico and Europe. SECOND, companies and other organisations (not artists) who want a unique collection for an office, a lobby, a home or a property. Both are buying something that exists once: a work made for them, or a work nobody else can own a copy of.
primary_goal: TWO actions, not one. (1) BUY from a collection — an existing original. (2) COMMISSION a work — engage Ivy Wolf to paint to the buyer's desire, priced by size against the published terms.
